body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a script (`build-full-beta-visual-required-inventory.mjs`) along with tests and generated artifacts to build a visual-required inventory for routing without blocking the text-first runtime. The review feedback focuses on enhancing the robustness of the script's input parsing and validation. Specifically, the reviewer recommends validating the shapes of parsed input files, explicitly checking for and recording malformed entries in the registry and crop risk collections, passing the diagnostics array to indexing functions, and ensuring that storage key construction fails closed by returning null when required fields are missing.
